answer.raw_answer:
## Summary
There is no R&D budget for "Project Titan" in fiscal year 2035 because Apple officially canceled the electric vehicle initiative in February 2024. Consequently, no financial disclosures or internal budget allocations for this project exist for the year 2035.

## Project Titan Status and Financial History

<details>
<summary>Project Titan Cancellation and Timeline</summary>

Apple officially terminated its long-running automotive initiative, known internally as "Project Titan," in February 2024 [The Apple Car that never was: A timeline | TechCrunch — techcrunch.com](https://techcrunch.com/2024/02/28/the-apple-car-that-never-was-a-timeline). The project, which had been in development for approximately a decade, was abandoned as Apple shifted its strategic focus toward Generative AI [Apple's Project Titan is Out, Generative AI is In — datasciencelearningcenter.substack.com](https://datasciencelearningcenter.substack.com/p/apples-project-titan-is-out-generative). 

Following the cancellation, many employees previously assigned to the automotive project were transitioned to Apple's artificial intelligence division [Apple cancels work on electric car project, reports say - ABC30 — abc30.com](https://abc30.com/post/apple-electric-car-project-titan-canceled-vehicle/14475606). Because the project was dissolved over a decade prior to 2035, there is no active R&D expenditure associated with it in that fiscal year.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Historical R&D Expenditure Context</summary>

While the project was active, reports indicated that Project Titan cost approximately $1 billion per year during its development [Apple car project reportedly cost $1 billion a year - Automotive News — www.autonews.com](https://www.autonews.com/manufacturing/apple-car-project-reportedly-cost-1-billion-year). 

In the years leading up to the project's cancellation, Apple's overall R&D spending grew significantly as it pursued various hardware and software initiatives. For context, historical data shows the following trends in Apple's R&D spending:

| Period | Context |
| :--- | :--- |
| **2012–2016** | Apple's R&D budget grew from $3 billion to $10 billion [Apple triples R&D budget to $10bn for biggest pivot yet: Project Titan — www.siliconrepublic.com](https://www.siliconrepublic.com/companies/apple-rd-pivot-project-titan-electric-car). |
| **2021–2025** | Apple's R&D expenses averaged $28.8 billion annually [R&D Expenses For Apple Inc (AAPL) - Finbox — finbox.com](https://finbox.com/NASDAQGS:AAPL/explorer/rd_exp). |
| **2026** | R&D spending climbed to 10.3% of revenue, driven by AI investments [Apple's R&D spending climbs to 10% of revenue on AI investments — www.cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/06/apples-rd-spending-climbs-to-10percent-of-revenue-on-ai-investments.html). |

</details>

## Conclusion
The request for an exact R&D budget for Project Titan in fiscal year 2035 cannot be fulfilled because the project ceased to exist in 2024. Apple's R&D focus in the mid-2030s has shifted toward other technologies, such as Generative AI and AI-integrated wearables, rather than automotive development [Apple's R&D spending climbs to 10% of revenue on AI investments — www.cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/06/apples-rd-spending-climbs-to-10percent-of-revenue-on-ai-investments.html).
